insights.title: The Texans may be without Nico Collins, who suffered a concussion in the Texans' Wild Card win against the Steelers.

Kayshon Boutte has had 10 receptions of at least 20 yards in 2025, totaling 270 receiving yards and four touchdowns, the most receiving touchdowns of at least 20 yards by a Patriots pass catcher this season.
Drake Maye threw his first career touchdown pass against the Texans in Week 6, 2024, a 40-yard score to Kayshon Boutte that beat the coverage of Derek Stingley Jr.

C.J. Stroud completed 66.7% of his pass attempts against man coverage in the red zone in the regular season, tied for the 3rd-highest mark among qualified quarterbacks, throwing 11 touchdowns without a single interception.

insights.title: In the Wild Card game, Drake Maye completed 6 of 9 passes for 122 yards and a touchdown against the Chargers blitz.
Rhamondre Stevenson was the Patriots leading receiver in the Wild Card round with 3 receptions for 75 yards on just 4 targets.
In the Wild Card Round, 11 different Patriots defenders generated at least one pressure, tied for their 2nd-most in a game this season.
The Patriots allowed just 36 yards against the Chargers 14 designed rushes in the Wild Card Round, their fewest in a game this season.
Across 26 coverage snaps in the Wild Card Round, Christian Gonzalez did not allow a single reception on any of his 5 targets faced.
In the Texans' Wild Card win, C.J. Stroud completed 8 of 14 pass attempts for 148 yards when under pressure, tied for the 2nd-most yards under pressure of his career.

insights.title: Christian Kirk caught 8 passes for 144 yards and a touchdown in the Wild Card round, recording 6 of those receptions for 132 yards and his lone score when covered by Brandin Echols, the most receiving yards against a single defender in a playoff game since at least 2018.
Woody Marks rushed 19 times for a career-high 112 yards and a touchdown against the Steelers.
Will Anderson Jr. (8) and Danielle Hunter (7) combined for 15 pressures and 1.5 sacks in the Wild card round, helping the Texans generate a 44.7% pressure rate, their 3rd-highest in a game in 2025.
The Texans defensive backs combined to allow 7 receptions for 48 yards across 15 targets (3.2 yards per target) in the Wild Card Round.

C.J. Stroud posted a league-high 64.7% success rate when targeting in-breaking routes this season, along with the 2nd-highest completion percentage (75.3%) and 2nd-most yards per attempt (10.7) behind only Jared Goff (11.0).

insights.title: The Patriots blitzed on 27.6% of opposing dropbacks during the regular season, the 14th-lowest rate in the NFL.

insights.title: The Patriots defense allowed 2.9 yards after contact per designed run this season (4th-fewest in NFL) despite giving up 1.2 yards before contact (10th-most).

Deploying base personnel on 25.7% of their defensive snaps (12th-lowest), the Patriots allowed just 3.2 yards per rush (6th-lowest), with only 5.6% gaining 10+ yards (6th-lowest), with four defensive backs on the field this season.
The Patriots missed just 11.3% of their tackle opportunities during the regular season (5th-lowest), but converted a league-low 58.0% of opportunities behind the line of scrimmage.

Christian Elliss tackled the ball carrier on 15.9% of his snaps (9th-highest among linebackers, min. 200 snaps), pressured the quarterback on 18.5% of his rushes (21st-highest, min. 50 pass rushes) and allowed 6.4 yards per target in coverage (21st-fewest, min. 25 targets).

insights.title: The Texans used jumbo personnel on 18.2% of offensive snaps this season (198 plays), the 2nd-highest jumbo usage in the league and an outsized contrast from their 1.1% usage in the previous two seasons combined.

The Patriots offense put 17 unique personnel groups on the field during the regular season, tied for the 3rd-most among all offenses this season and the most for the Patriots since 2019 with Josh McDaniels in his second stint with the team.

Prior to Week 11 the Patriots had deployed Jumbo personnel (6+ OL) just five total times (0.8%, 9th-lowest), but in their last seven regular season games the Patriots utilized 6+ offensive linemen on 17.4% of their snaps (4th-highest).
The Patriots utilized 22 personnel on a season-high 35.9% of their offensive snaps in their Wild Card game against the Chargers, the 2nd-highest rate of any offense in a game this season.

Despite aligning in the shotgun at the 9th-lowest rate this season (53.2%), the Patriots gained the most yards per play (7.1), earned the highest success rate (50.6%) and generated the highest explosive play rate (18.7%) from the shotgun than any other offense this season.
Stefon Diggs was held to just 16 receiving yards on 2 catches in the Wild Card Round vs the Chargers.
Mike Vrabel and DeMeco Ryans will be the 4th pair of head coaches to meet in the playoffs that both made the Pro Bowl as players in the same season – both were named Pro Bowlers in 2007.
Christian Kirk has had a receiving touchdown in each of his last 3 playoff games played.
The Texans have won 16 consecutive games, including the playoffs, when they score at least 20 points in a game.
Drake Maye will face the Texans top-ranked total defense – allowing just 277.2 yards per game – in the Divisional Round.
C.J. Stroud is the 5th quarterback all-time to reach the Divisional Round of the playoffs in each of their first 3 seasons.
The Patriots are 24-5 all-time at home in the playoffs, which is the 2nd-best home playoff W-L in NFL history behind the Cardinals at 5-0.
The Patriots have won 8 consecutive games in the Divisional Round of the NFL Playoffs, the longest winning streak by any team in a single playoff round in NFL history.
The Patriots have won 28 playoff games and appeared in 12 conference championship games since 2002 realignment, both the most in the NFL over that span.
